name: Engineering Behaviour of Soils
description: Origin, nature, and distribution of soils. Clay mineralogy, clay-water-electrolytes. Soil particles characteristics, fabric, and structure. Effective stress principle. Steady state flows in the soil. Effect of flow on effective stress. Consolidation of soils - one, two, three and radial. Total and effective stress-path. Triaxial, direct shear, direct simple shear tests. Shear behaviour of soils under static and dynamic loads. Shear strength and pore pressure parameters. Factors affecting strength: stress history, rate of testing, structure, and temperature. Anisotropy of strength, thixotropy, creep. Determination of in-situ undrained strength. Stress-strain characteristics of soils. Determination modulus values. Critical state model. Engineering behaviour of soils of India.
